definitions.short: to ride (on an animal or in a vehicle); causatively, to place upon (for riding or generally), to despatch
definitions.usage: bring (on (horse-) back), carry, get (oneself) up, on (horse-) back, put, (cause to, make to) ride (in a chariot, on, -r), set.
